  `evidence/surface_chat_prompt.txt` and `evidence/surface_chat_2026-10-31.txt` are a single claude.ai prompt and response made for the action-surface comparison. The prompt contains the CONTRACT.md rule text, `resume.personal.location` from the fictional priya-nair persona, and three fields of public Greenhouse posting 8335469 (id, title, location). The response file contains a header line (date, with time and model placeholders) and the model's verdict and justification. Nothing personal is included: no personal data and no other conversation history.
- Task instructions and decisions throughout, including answers to the clarifying questions Claude Code asked.

## CONTRACT.md
`CONTRACT.md` started from a template drafted in a claude.ai chat, which Meena edited. Its placeholders were resolved with that chat's help (commits `1ce1af0`, `94f5ede`, `9c8c20a`). In this repo, Claude Code only read `CONTRACT.md` and flagged unresolved placeholders; it never edited the file.

## External sources
- Greenhouse public Job Board API, board `cloudflare`: `https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/cloudflare/jobs?content=true`, fetched once on 2026-10-31 at 18:21:00Z (`evidence/raw/20261031T182100Z_live.json`). Posting content belongs to Cloudflare.
- the-reallocation-engine, `search/examples/priya-nair/`: the fictional persona `resume.example.json`, copied unmodified to `resume/persona.json`. `profile.yml` from the same folder was read for the target roles that CONTRACT.md fixes as rule keywords.
- Claude models: `claude-sonnet-5-5` for every Claude judge call and the file-read surface call. The model for Meena's claude.ai chat run was not recorded.
